title: Iteration of the encoded state update
statement: For every input bit string $x$, streaming seam state $s$, and integer $k\ge 0$, iterating the encoded next-state function $k$ times from the encoding of $s$ gives the encoding of the state obtained by iterating the structured round-state update $k$ times from $s$.
replaced:
For every input $x$, seam state $s$, and $k$, the $k$-fold iterate of the encoded
next-state function on the encoded word of $s$ equals the encoded word of the
$k$-fold iterate of the structured round map on $s$.
